#### Fix missing leading semicolon before a broken ternary with `--no-semi` and `--experimental-ternaries` (#18965 by @Saadanjum0)

<!-- prettier-ignore -->
```jsx
// Input
let o = 1;
(
  1 ||
  12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890
) ? 2 : 3;

// Prettier stable
let o = 1
(
  1 ||
  12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890
) ?
  2
: 3

// Prettier main
let o = 1
;(
  1 ||
  12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890
) ?
  2
: 3
```
